posts.title: AI Agents and the Refactoring That Never Happens
posts.description: Working with AI agents day to day, I've started noticing a trend that worries me. posts.title: Seamless Postgres Indexing in Rails: The Case for Delayed Migrations
posts.description: Adding an index to an existing table column might seem straightforward. However, PostgreSQL requires a SHARE lock to create a standard index. This mode conflicts with common write operations like INSERT , UPDATE , and DELETE , which use the ROW EXCLUSIVE lock mode. These articles explain the issue in depth: Postgres Schema Migration without Downtime Best Practice How to Use Postgres CREATE INDEX C

posts.title: Upgrading 200 GB Postgres within 10 minutes in Heroku
posts.description: I joined a new project 4 months ago. While investigating a slow query I noticed that even after creating a new covering index the query planner would refuse to use it. We were running Postgres 15 and I decided to try Postgres 17 and confirmed it would use the covering index as expected which significantly improved the query performance.
